scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street scene with a tall building in the background and a person riding a bicycle in the foreground. The street has a bike lane and a pedestrian crossing. There are several parked motorcycles along the sidewalk and a few trees lining the street. The building has a mix of pink and tan colored walls with balconies on each floor. The ground floor has a large entranceway with a sign reading 'Casa de la Vella' above it. The street is paved with asphalt and has white painted lines indicating lanes and crosswalks. A person is riding a bicycle down the street, wearing a yellow backpack. The sky is overcast.
